fields.title: Configure Retries
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each call, assign a timeout, number of retries, and whether a circuit breaker is needed.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Promo code check on input 2. Card charge 3. Sending store notification 4. Fetching rating for a product card
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — 2 s, no retries, circuit breaker not needed: user is right there. 2 — 10 s, 3 retries with backoff, no circuit breaker, critical. 3 — background, up to 10 attempts over an hour, circuit breaker present. 4 — 500 ms, 1 retry, circuit breaker with a low threshold: service is optional. Rule of thumb: if a user is waiting — short timeouts and few retries; if background — delivery matters, not speed.
